thread:
Devin (AE): Heads-up — Acme renewal coming up. They want to drop from Committed-3 -> Committed-1 and request a 25% uplift discount for the new term because usage dropped during POC. Need pricing guidance + deal desk sign-off.
Mia (AM): Got it. Are they asking to keep the same committed spend duration? Any tech blockers?
Devin (AE): Same 12‑month term. Main blockers: (1) security questionnaire still has KMS/data residency Qs open, (2) they want pro-rated credits if we reduce SKUs mid-term, (3) want lower committed unit price.
Marco (SE): For the POC we left a VPC peering stub, they need access to private endpoints to validate latency. I can re-open environment for 2 weeks if security signoff is quick.
Mia (AM): @Ashley can deal desk weigh in on the 25% off + pro-rate credit ask? This is a < $100k ARR account, strategic but small.
Ashley (DealDesk): 25% is outside standard guidance for renewals on committed tiers. Standard uplift/window discount cap is 15% without VP approval. Pro-rate credits for mid-term SKU reduction need Legal and Finance sign-off — usually only for migration exceptions.
Devin (AE): Understood. Is 15% achievable without escalating? Customer is pushing hard, arguing they underutilized because of integration delays.
Ashley (DealDesk): 15% OK with a single-exec approval. For anything >15% we need written justification + revenue leader sign-off. Also require a special-term clause limiting future mid-term downshifts to once per term.
Irene (Legal): If we grant pro-rate credits, Legal needs the exact clause: formula and cap. Suggest: "Pro-rate credits for SKU downgrade = remaining committed value * 20% cap, one-time per 12-month term." We can draft if Finance approves the cap.
dealdesk-bot: To start approval, submit PR-REQ with: account name, current ARR, requested net ARR, proposed discount %, and justification. Template: https://redwood.company/dealdesk/template (fill fields: justification, CFO rationale, migration notes).
Marco (SE): Security Qs — quick checklist: KMS (yes=customer-managed ok), data residency (we can lock to eu-west-1), penetration test report (we have last quarter). I can package answers today if you want.
Mia (AM): Please do. Devin, get the PR-REQ started with Ashley's guidance. I'll coordinate tech answers with Marco so Legal can draft the pro-rate clause.
Devin (AE): Will do. Projection: submit PR-REQ by EOD, target internal approval in 48h. Tagging @Ashley for follow-up. :thumbsup:
Ashley (DealDesk): Cool. If you flag it as "renewal exception" I will route to VP queue. Also include estimated churn risk if we deny.
Devin (AE): Adding churn risk note. Thanks all — will update thread when PR-REQ is in.
Mia (AM): Thanks — remind Acme we need signed security attestation to unblock the POC access.
Marco (SE): Packaging security artifacts now.
Irene (Legal): Once clause language approved, send to me for final review before counterparty signature.
Devin (AE): PR-REQ submitted: https://redwood.company/review/PR-12345. Marking this thread resolved for now — will post outcome. :white_check_mark:
